metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Bootstrap Sequence
metadata.description: Canonical boot sequence for initializing FFT AI Edition in AI systems, including load order, validation, and substrate activation.

boot_profile.notes: This sequence assumes access to the AI Edition directory, registry, spec, core, substrate, and examples.

stages.name: Discover AI Edition
stages.description: Locate and load the AI Edition manifest and registry.

stages.name: Load Core Module
stages.description: Initialize the minimal FFT AI core (regime, invariant, clarity operator).

stages.name: Load Full Specification
stages.description: Load the full FFT AI spec including structures, types, and validation profiles.

stages.name: Load Hardware Substrate
stages.description: Load hardware-ready conceptual substrate for FFT kernels.

stages.name: Bind Hardware Profile
stages.description: Bind hardware capability profile to substrate and spec.
actions: Verify compatibility with fft.ai.substrate.json and fft.ai.spec.json

stages.name: Activate Validation Profiles
stages.description: Enable RTT/FFT validation for inference and hardware execution.
actions: Activate vp.hardware.default for hardware execution (if available)

stages.name: Load Examples
stages.description: Load canonical examples for testing and calibration.
